company.name: LegalTech Middle East
company.shortDescription: LegalTech ME is a specialized legal technology service provider to create a digital transformation in the legal industry
company.description:
We are an all-in-one, comprehensive legal technology solutions provider to help your firm stay atop the competitive legal market, directing to take the legal industry to the next level with the implementation of technology and to overcome the challenges currently being faced, with a keen focus on our main industry transformer factors – Change, Scale, Focus and Connect.

With the importance of technology being recognized along with its increasing demand in the legal industry, we understand what exactly your legal firm requires. LegalTech ME has been created to shed light on digitalization and the massive changes happening in the industry, with the help of Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence.

With expertise and knowledge of both IT and legal sector, we provide as well as develop software and building solutions, along with other areas of practice such as legal expertise and knowledge, legal IT solutions, legal research and development, legal training, data migration, and more.
